texts.preamble: Goldripe International Pvt. Ltd., vs The State Of Andhra Pradesh on 11 August, 2022 Author: K.Suresh Reddy Bench: K.Suresh Reddy The Hon'Ble Sri Justice K.Suresh Reddy Writ Petition No. 3545 Of 2021 Order:
texts.facts: It is only after various pronouncements by different High Courts, Government has taken steps to implement the ban on using Calcium Carbide. It is only thereafter, farmer communities started using Ethylene gas chambers for ripening fruits. As it costs lot of expenditure, products like En-ripe and Ethephon, i.e. products of respondent No. 3 and the petitioners respectively, came into existence for ripening fruits. Of course, both of them are not banned by Government and both the products are approved by FSSAI. In spite of the same, respondent Nos. 1 and 2 are either encouraging the product of respondent No. 3 i.e. En-ripe or interfering with the business activities of the petitioners.
texts.arguments: 2. The grievance of the petitioners in the present writ petition is that in spite of there being material that use of Ethephon (Ethylene ripener sachets) is not objectionable for ripening fruits, respondent Nos. 1 and 2 are either interfering with or discouraging the said use. 3. Learned senior counsel submits that use of Ethephon in powder form was approved by Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (hereinafter referred to as 'FSSAI') by Guidance Note No. 04/2018. The said Ethephon chemical produces Ethylene gas which is not a banned substance. Earlier, the farmer communities use Calcium Carbide gas also known as Acetylene gas for ripening fruits. The said Calcium Carbide gas was banned by Government in 1970's. In spite of the same, all the traders are using the said Calcium Carbide. 4. In support of his contentions, learned senior counsel places reliance on Nalin Venkat Kishore Kumar and another Vs. Food Safety and Standards Authority of India and others1, wherein a Division Bench of the High Court for the State of Telangana, after considering all the aspects, permitted to use both En-ripe and Ethephon as both of them are approved by FSSAI and also places reliance on a judgment of the High Court of Delhi in Shivashish Dwivedi and another Vs. Food Safety and Standards Authority of India and others2. Goldripe International Pvt. Ltd., vs The State Of Andhra Pradesh on 11 August, 2022 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/116882352/ 1 5. On the other hand, learned Government Pleader for Agriculture filed counter affidavit on behalf of respondent No. 2. Learned Government Pleader, on instructions, submits that respondent Nos. 1 and 2 will not interfere with the business activities of the petitioners so long as the said product is not banned. Learned Government Pleader further submits that respondent Nos. 1 and 2 are also not encouraging farmer communities to use any particular product.
